coordinate_convention: Zero-based, matching the final v2 manifest.

policy.authority: Private handoff of ONLY final V3 new contextual approvals (84) and direct J6 human confirmations (3); original V2 recoveries and the already-published KT201 U correction are excluded.
policy.supported_changes: Owners may patch only the specifically supported text fields and corresponding semantic references or labels. Preserve surviving literal signs, qualifiers, spelling, and placement. Do not silently force printed source discrepancies to a peer’s wording.
policy.before_snapshots: Before applying a reading, preserve the current TXT, source-layout model, verification/review notes, preview quartet, relevant source model/generator, and source TIFF provenance with exact hashes. Preserve historical confirmation and review records.
policy.physical_print_vs_inference: Keep the original fragment, covered marker cells, and source-derived inference provenance. A uniquely recovered reading does not make a physically damaged glyph legible. Record native physical uncertainty separately from logical recovery and any new human confirmation.
policy.geometry: Do not alter wire routes, junctions, crossings, pins, grid glyphs, block placement, or other layout solely because of these recoveries. Any separately established wiring or geometry correction requires its own source evidence and review.
policy.preconditions: Check each stable ID against the current source scan, target fragment, coordinates, semantic field boundaries, and current hashes before editing. Explicit full-field boundary repairs and virtual masks are preserved in the decision; do not treat an unknown-length placeholder as a one-character reading.
policy.independent_reacceptance: After supported edits, independently inspect the current TIFF and the complete current TXT/model/verification-or-review-notes/preview quartet, including the full-page preview. Reaccept the page with current source and artifact hashes before any repository mirroring.
policy.mirroring: Mirror only the independently reaccepted current artifacts and receipts through the established owner workflow. These handoffs themselves grant no page acceptance and make no repository or canonical changes.
policy.human_history: Never replace a prior raw human answer with a source-derived reading. The LS023/LS113 raw answers remain literally illegible; their already owner-applied recoveries are archived separately and excluded from the 494 new handoffs.
policy.unresolved_scope: Only these reviewed fields are supported. Other physical questions, tentative guesses, source limitations, and wiring checks remain separate and open unless independently resolved.
policy.publication: No canonical, repository, source, owner, or workbook changes have been made. A1 root-retained 55 contextual readings and 3 direct confirmations remain private pending root publication; no owner was invented or messaged.
policy.current_hash_changes: Current target and proof hashes were checked at preparation. Changed targets remain bound to exact current before bytes; owner must rebind semantic field boundaries and current acceptance. Already-present exact readings must not be blindly reapplied.

reusable_contextual_checks.failure: Never relabel a model inference or historical review note as a human or literal source reading.

reusable_contextual_checks.failure: No closure without readable evidence; no silent ID replacement or loss of a received answer.

reusable_contextual_checks.required: Every literal cited field must match a current accepted text SHA256 and exact row/column excerpt. Retain model SHA where used for locating but verify the literal against raw accepted text.
reusable_contextual_checks.failure: Reject High if hashes, excerpts or acceptance changed.

reusable_contextual_checks.required: Use the original actual printed field mask, preserve every surviving character and its position, and retain covered cells. Never use normalized subject-model values as readable corroboration.
reusable_contextual_checks.failure: Readable-source disagreement is a conflict, not permission to normalize.

reusable_contextual_checks.required: Bind references with readable actual board/socket plus page/card/portion as applicable. Board identity must come from printed footer or directly confirmed context; ambiguous location symbols require joint source masks.
reusable_contextual_checks.failure: A similar card type on another socket is a tentative analogy.

reusable_contextual_checks.required: Read the complementary page, accepted socket summary or actual other-page block; retain complete headings and relevant surrounding lines. Model/net derivation from the damaged subject scan is not independent evidence.
reusable_contextual_checks.failure: Keep physical wire gaps open if only the derived graph supports continuity.

reusable_contextual_checks.required: Enumerate all exact physically compatible source candidates together with the actual subject mask and surrounding fields. Record real alternatives at the same exact identity, not unrelated global card-code matches.
reusable_contextual_checks.failure: Two compatible exact-source choices remain Tentative or Unresolved.

reusable_contextual_checks.required: Treat all continuation rows of one socket/page listing as one ordered list. Parse the actual token slots and surviving anchors; compare complete multiplicity-preserving readable counterpart portions, not each damaged token against all card portions independently.
reusable_contextual_checks.failure: Do not call all portions competitors without list constraints; do not silently discard duplicates or unused portions.

reusable_contextual_checks.required: Document why the specific listing grammar is ordered (direct human confirmation here; otherwise independent readable examples of the same listing format with consistent ordering). For alphabetic enumeration preserve actual skipped letters such as I. Require a unique whole-list assignment under that established grammar.
reusable_contextual_checks.failure: Set completeness alone leaves B1/C1 permutations unresolved. Source diagram spatial order does not establish socket-list token order.

reusable_contextual_checks.required: Use column boundaries, socket headers and list continuation indentation to establish which fields belong together. Preserve their complete printed contexts.
reusable_contextual_checks.failure: Grid placement or a global convention alone does not prove an unreadable literal.

reusable_contextual_checks.required: Record explicit human readings as human-confirmed with exact message and stable IDs. Keep independently inferred automatic recoveries separately identified and preserve tentative alternatives/conflicts.
reusable_contextual_checks.failure: Never relabel a model inference or historical review note as a human or literal source reading.

reusable_contextual_checks.required: Review every proposed High against its raw evidence and whole-context alternatives. Preserve original stable IDs, existing answers and field coverage; append v3 decisions without modifying the v2 workbook currently being filled.
reusable_contextual_checks.failure: No closure without readable evidence; no silent ID replacement or loss of a received answer.

a1_results: Review part numbers against exact board/socket plug summaries with heading/footer evidence.
Review portion codes as complete socket/page lists with list grammar, all continuation rows, readable anchors and exact counterpart blocks.
Require unique joint mask/context assignment, retaining exact-source alternatives and human authority separately.
non_a1_results: Bind actual readable block card/portion and physical socket jointly to A1 references; preserve damaged masks rather than accepted model normalization.
Check same-page repeated literal fields only where raw text is actually readable and uniquely compatible.
Do not close physical connections from graph inference alone; retain logical best guesses and conflicts.
every_high_required: Full context uniquely binds the actual physical identity and field.
Any sequence/order constraint has recorded literal or direct human authority.
Human-confirmed versus automated inference explicitly distinguished.
